parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of plastic, typically circular and slightly convex to fit securely on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the trash contained. It may include a handle or hinge for easy opening.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated to open and close the trash can.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of durable plastic, cylindrical in shape, and designed to hold waste.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main compartment for collecting and storing trash until disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or carried when emptying the trash.
